pages.title: Samotherium
pages.text: Samotherium ($(o)Samotherium boissieri$()) is an extinct giraffid that lived around the eastern Mediterranean during the Late Miocene, named after the Greek island of Samos where it was first found.$(br2)It had a neck intermediate in length between that of the okapi and the giraffe, and a pair of upward-pointing ossicones that curved backwards.$(br2)Its rounded muzzle and tooth wear suggest it grazed in open grasslands.
